svg.title: David Álvarez (0xDA_bit) · IoT Engineer
svg.desc: David Álvarez (0xDA_bit), IoT Engineer based in Barcelona, Spain. 15+ years in IoT and 25+ years in hardware. B.Eng. in Industrial Electronics Engineering. Focus: ESP32, ESP8266, ESP-IDF, Apple HomeKit, Tasmota; industrial embedded Linux with Docker, Kubernetes and SquashFS images; Raspberry Pi, embedded hardware/software, smart home and AI. Languages: Bash, C, C++, Go, Java, Python, React, TypeScript; learning Rust. Open to remote or hybrid opportunities.
